edit.description: the failure-stage roster, the per-stage fold, and the non-zero-exit leg that today only counts the tick as errored
the backstop's cases over a child that writes no verdict

summary: an `exit` stage records a child that exited non-zero without writing a verdict, keyed by its exit code, so a pre-verdict refusal feeds the abort backstop

per.section: Repeated identical failures — quarantine, then abort

acceptance: a run whose children repeatedly exit non-zero with no verdict on disk aborts on the threshold naming the `exit` stage and the code, instead of spending `--max`; the record is blamed on no entry, so it places no quarantine hold
tests: a child exiting non-zero with no verdict joins the failure accounting under its exit code
a run aborts on the threshold of identical verdictless exits
pins: a child that exits zero joins no failure accounting
a verdictless exit places no quarantine hold on any entry
notes: `FAILURE_STAGES` carries six members, all read off a verdict; the verdictless exit is counted into `erroredTicks` alone and reaches no signature. This stage is the one the spec says the *missing* verdict states, so the fold has no verdict list to key on — `platform` is the shape to follow (no tag, backstop only). `LIFTS_ON_A_MOVED_TIP` is a membership set, so a new member keeps the run-scoped default with no edit.
